name: Area 52, Netherstorm
shortDescription: Area 52, Netherstorm, a named setting in the Karazhan research story.
body: The associated original environment art preserves these Goblins’ expedition hub of riveted metal, patched canvas, pipes and raised walkways under Netherstorm’s violet sky and floating rock fragments. It remains an interpretive scene; no exact route, dungeon layout or surveyed coordinate is asserted.
